arabicText:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴾
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴾
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴾
transliteration: Surat Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas (3 times each).
translationEnglish: Say: He is Allah, the One... Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak... Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind...
virtue: Whoever recites them three times in the morning and evening, they will suffice him against everything (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

titleEnglish: On the Natural Disposition of Islam
arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini Nabiyyina Muhammadin sallAllahu 'alayhi wa sallam...
translationEnglish: We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the statement of pure faith, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad...
virtue: Affirmation of adherence to pure monotheism and prophetic guidance (Ahmad & Sahih Al-Jami).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ.
transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
translationEnglish: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and unto You is the resurrection.
virtue: Morning declaration of complete reliance on Allah (Tirmidhi).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...
translationEnglish: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth...
virtue: The Prophet never neglected this supplication in the morning and evening (Abu Dawud & Ibn Majah).

titleArabic: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث
titleEnglish: O Ever-Living, by Your Mercy I Seek Help
arabicText: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
translationEnglish: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek assistance. Rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
virtue: Prophetic instruction to Fatima for daily morning and evening serenity (An-Nasa'i).

titleArabic: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو
arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
transliteration: HasbiyAllahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhim.
translationEnglish: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
virtue: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him in whatever worries him (Abu Dawud).

arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatih.
translationEnglish: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, by the number of His creation, by the pleasure of Himself, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
virtue: Outweighs all morning dhikr in reward (Muslim).

titleEnglish: Glory and Praise to Allah (100 times)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih.
translationEnglish: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
virtue: Whoever says this 100 times in the morning, his sins will be forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleEnglish: We Have Entered Evening on the Natural Faith
arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini Nabiyyina Muhammadin...
translationEnglish: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the statement of pure faith, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad...
virtue: Evening affirmation of the primordial faith and pure monotheism (Ahmad & Sahih Al-Jami).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.
translationEnglish: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and unto You is our return.
virtue: Evening surrender and devotion to Allah (Tirmidhi).

titleArabic: سؤال خير هذه الليلة والتعوذ من شرها
titleEnglish: Asking for the Good of This Night
arabicText: رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
transliteration: Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha...
translationEnglish: My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this night and the evil of what comes after it...
virtue: Part of the authentic evening supplication recorded in Sahih Muslim (Muslim).

titleArabic: دعاء العافية في البدن والسمع والبصر
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Ant...
translationEnglish: O Allah, grant health to my body. O Allah, grant health to my hearing. O Allah, grant health to my sight. There is no deity except You...
virtue: Recited thrice in the morning and evening for complete physical and spiritual protection (Abu Dawud).

titleEnglish: Knower of the Unseen and the Witnessed
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard...
translationEnglish: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You...
virtue: Taught by the Prophet to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq to say morning, evening, and upon taking to bed (Tirmidhi & Abu Dawud).

arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ.
transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu...
translationEnglish: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. His is the sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things...
virtue: Recited by the Messenger of Allah after concluding every obligatory prayer (Muslim).

titleEnglish: None Can Withhold What You Give
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ.
transliteration: Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
translationEnglish: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, nor can the possession of wealth benefit anyone against You.
virtue: Confirmed Sunnah recited upon concluding prayer (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleEnglish: Help Me Remember and Thank You
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ.
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.
translationEnglish: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.
virtue: The Prophet took Mu'adh by the hand and counseled him never to forget saying this at the end of every prayer (Abu Dawud).

titleArabic: اللهم إني أسألك علما نافعا بعد الفجر
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala.
translationEnglish: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and acceptable deeds.
virtue: Recited by the Prophet upon completing the Salam of the Fajr prayer (Ibn Majah & Ahmad).

arabicText: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun...
translationEnglish: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers...
virtue: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surat Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleEnglish: In Your Name O Allah I Die and Live
arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا.
transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
translationEnglish: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live.
virtue: Supplicated by the Prophet whenever he reclined in bed to sleep (Bukhari).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk...
translationEnglish: O Allah, I surrender my soul unto You, entrust my affair to You, turn my face towards You, and rely upon You...
virtue: If you die that night after saying this, you die upon the natural pure faith (Fitrah) (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleArabic: تسبيح النوم (٣٣ سبحان الله، ٣٣ الحمد لله، ٣٤ الله أكبر)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣ مَرَّةً) ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مَرَّةً) ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مَرَّةً).
transliteration: SubhanAllah (33x), Alhamdulillah (33x), Allahu Akbar (34x).
translationEnglish: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is greatest (34 times).
virtue: Taught by the Prophet to Ali and Fatima; superior for strength than a servant (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleArabic: الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وآوانا
titleEnglish: Praise to Allah Who Provided Us Shelter
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana wa awana...
translationEnglish: Praise be to Allah Who fed us and gave us drink, provided for us and gave us shelter, for how many are there who have none to suffice them or shelter them.
virtue: Gratitude for the day's nourishment, safety, and shelter (Muslim).

titleArabic: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
translationEnglish: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
virtue: The Prophet placed his right hand under his cheek and recited this three times before sleeping (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana mil-ladunka rahmah, innaka Antal-Wahhab.
translationEnglish: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower. (Surah Ali 'Imran 3:8)
virtue: Protection against spiritual wavering and loss of guidance.

arabicText: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
translationEnglish: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous. (Surah Al-Furqan 25:74)
virtue: Supplication of the righteous servants of the Most Merciful.

arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
translationEnglish: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established. (Surah Ibrahim 14:41)
virtue: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim embracing parents and the whole community of faith.

titleArabic: دعاء ذي النون في بطن الحوت
arabicText: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
translationEnglish: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers. (Surah Al-Anbiya 21:87)
virtue: No Muslim supplicates with this in any distress except that Allah relieves him (Tirmidhi).

arabicText: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
translationEnglish: My Lord, increase me in knowledge. (Surah Taha 20:114)
virtue: The only matter Allah commanded His Prophet to ask for an increase in is knowledge.

arabicText: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
translationEnglish: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small. (Surah Al-Isra 17:24)
virtue: Fulfills the supreme duty of kindness and prayers for mother and father.

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
translationEnglish: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
virtue: A comprehensive protective prayer constantly made by the Messenger of Allah (Bukhari).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ.
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlikal-'adhim, fa-innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir...
translationEnglish: O Allah, I ask for Your great blessings, for You have power and I have none, You know and I know not, and You know the unseen...
virtue: The Prophet taught the Companions Istikharah in all matters just as he taught them a Surah from the Quran (Bukhari).

arabicText: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ.
transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
translationEnglish: O Turner of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
virtue: The most frequent personal supplication made by the Prophet ﷺ (Tirmidhi & Ahmad).

arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
transliteration: SubhanakAllahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu alla ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
translationEnglish: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
virtue: Recited before rising from any gathering; whatever occurred therein of lapse is expiated (Tirmidhi & Abu Dawud).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'Afuwwun Karimun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.
translationEnglish: O Allah, You are Most Forgiving and Generous, You love to forgive, so forgive me.
virtue: The prayer specifically taught by the Prophet to Aisha to recite during blessed nights (Tirmidhi).

titleArabic: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا
titleEnglish: Praise to Allah Who Brought Us to Life
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
translationEnglish: Praise is to Allah Who gives us life after He caused us to die, and unto Him is the resurrection.
virtue: Sunnah upon opening eyes in the morning (Bukhari & Muslim).

titleArabic: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي
titleEnglish: Gratitude for Physical Health Upon Waking
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bi-dhikrih.
translationEnglish: Praise is to Allah Who gave strength to my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
virtue: Acknowledges bodily vigor and divine permission to worship on a new day (Tirmidhi).

titleEnglish: Dua While Walking to the Mosque
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا.
transliteration: Allahummaj-'al fi qalbi nura, wa fi lisani nura, wa fi sam'i nura...
translationEnglish: O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and above me light, and beneath me light...
virtue: The prayer recited by the Prophet on his way to dawn prayer (Bukhari & Muslim).

arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
transliteration: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
virtue: Recited with the right foot entering the sanctuary (Muslim & Abu Dawud).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika, Allahumma'simni minash-shaytanir-rajim.
translationEnglish: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty; O Allah, protect me from the outcast devil.
virtue: Recited with the left foot departing the mosque (Muslim & Ibn Majah).

arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alAllahi, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except by Allah.
virtue: It is said to him: You are guided, defended, and protected, and devils stay away from him (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ.
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw azlima aw uzlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayy.
translationEnglish: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be made to slip, oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.
virtue: The Prophet raised his eyes to the heavens and said this whenever leaving his residence (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا.
transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
virtue: Followed by greeting the household with Salam; prevents the devil from staying the night (Abu Dawud & Muslim).

arabicText:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
(فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ).
transliteration: Bismillah. (If forgotten: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu).
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah. (If forgotten at the beginning, say: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end).
virtue: Prevents Shaytan from partaking in the meal (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
translationEnglish: Praise be to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part.
virtue: Whoever says this upon finishing food, his previous minor sins are forgiven (Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi & Ibn Majah).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ.
transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.
translationEnglish: O Allah, bless for them that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.
virtue: Prophetic sunnah recited after partaking in someone's hospitality (Muslim).

titleArabic: دعاء ركوب الدابة أو وسيلة النقل
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ﴿ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ ﴾، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
transliteration: Bismillah, Alhamdu lillah, Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha...
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah, praise be to Allah. Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have achieved it by our own efforts...
virtue: Sunnah upon boarding a vehicle or mounting travel (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ.
transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa...
translationEnglish: O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us and make its distance short...
virtue: The comprehensive traveler's prayer practiced consistently by the Prophet (Muslim).

arabicText: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun.
translationEnglish: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
virtue: Repeated when returning from journey and arriving safely back home (Muslim).

arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
transliteration: Bismillah.
translationEnglish: In the name of Allah.
virtue: Sunnah upon initiating the ritual purification (Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ.
transliteration: Ash-hadu alla ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh.
translationEnglish: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, without partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
virtue: Whoever performs wudu thoroughly and recites this, the eight gates of Paradise are opened for him to enter from whichever he wills (Muslim).

titleEnglish: Make Me of the Repentant and Pure
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ.
transliteration: Allahummaj-'alni minat-tawwabina waj-'alni minal-mutatahhirin.
translationEnglish: O Allah, make me of the repentant and make me of those who purify themselves.
virtue: Combines inner moral repentance with outer physical purification (Tirmidhi).

arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahul-'Adhimul-Halim, la ilaha illAllahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhim, la ilaha illAllahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim.
translationEnglish: There is no deity except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne...
virtue: The Messenger of Allah invoked Allah with these words at times of severe distress (Bukhari & Muslim).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullah, la ilaha illa Ant.
translationEnglish: O Allah, Your mercy I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and rectify for me all my affairs. There is no deity except You.
virtue: Prophetic prescription for anxiety and grief (Abu Dawud & Ahmad).

arabicText: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ.
transliteration: HasbunAllahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
translationEnglish: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
virtue: Uttered by Ibrahim when cast into fire, and by Muhammad when told enemies had gathered against them (Bukhari).

arabicText: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا.
transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha.
translationEnglish: Truly to Allah we belong and truly unto Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and grant me a better substitute in its place.
virtue: Whoever says this in adversity, Allah rewards him in his calamity and grants him better than what was lost (Muslim).

arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
translationEnglish: Praise be to Allah Who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might on my part.
virtue: Forgives past minor sins (Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText:
لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ.
transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'Allah. As'alullahal-'Adhima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adhimi an yashfiyak.
translationEnglish: No harm, it will be a purification [of sins] if Allah wills. I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you.
virtue: Recited 7 times beside a sick person whose term has not come, and Allah will cure him (Bukhari, Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi).

arabicText: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ.
transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhadha, wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullun 'indahu bi-ajalim-musamma, faltasbir wal-tahtasib.
translationEnglish: Indeed to Allah belongs what He took, and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term, so be patient and hope for reward.
virtue: The prophetic condolence message for patience and solace (Bukhari & Muslim).

arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا.
transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.
translationEnglish: O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour.
virtue: Sunnah upon receiving rain from the skies (Bukhari).

arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bi-hamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih.
translationEnglish: Glory be to Him Whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels from the awe of Him.
virtue: Recited by Ibn Az-Zubayr upon hearing thunder (Muwatta Malik & Sahih Al-Adab Al-Mufrad).

arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.
transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam...
translationEnglish: Allah is greatest. O Allah, bring this crescent upon us with peace, faith, safety and Islam, and guidance to that which You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
virtue: Prophetic supplication at the advent of every new lunar month (Tirmidhi & Ahmad).
